name: Fairy Angel
source:
This is a short adventure game about magical girls. There's only two real choices which lead to bad endings for the main characters.

[Edited from [url=https://www.pc98.org/fairya.html]pc98.org[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于魔法少女的短篇冒险游戏。只有两个真正的选择会导致主角的糟糕结局。
